name: Cable Single-Arm Rotational Row
steps: Stand facing a chest-height cable in a staggered stance and reach toward it with one hand, letting that shoulder turn forward.
Pull the handle toward your ribs as you turn your chest away from the pulley.
Extend your arm and turn back to the start.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Allow your feet to pivot with the turn.
Keep your torso upright and control the return instead of letting the cable yank your shoulder forward.
